answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1599 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the grove. The sable index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the wharf queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Verification alone takes 10 days each. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
